title: Adapter

act2.summary: a third reader, with a third shape

solutions.title: one FareReader, adapters for everything that doesn't speak it
solutions.tradeoff: A third reader shape costs one small adapter class and a one-line delegate - the admission rule itself is written exactly once. The price: every reader shape now has to be wrapped before it can be used, which is one more file to open when tracing how a single station actually admits someone.

reviewFocus: Does admitPassenger's body mention anything about dollars, legacy status strings, or the contactless wire format?
If a fourth reader shape arrived tomorrow, would it cost a new adapter file, or would it also touch admit.ts on the solution route?
Is the duplicated logic in src/admit.ts actually three copies of the same rule, or have they already drifted (rounding, comparison, refusal reason strings)?
Would a single FareReader adapter that took a 'kind' parameter and branched internally be better or worse than three small adapter classes?
